skill.name: context-degradation
skill.description: Diagnose context degradation in AI agent systems and apply mitigation patterns for long-context reliability.
skill.summary: Guides diagnosis and mitigation of lost-in-middle, poisoning, distraction, confusion, and context clash patterns.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can lose accuracy when context grows, conflicts, or includes distracting material. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code identify degradation patterns and choose practical mitigation steps.
actual_capabilities: Explains lost-in-middle behavior and why placement affects recall.
Defines context poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash with symptoms.
Recommends write, select, compress, and isolate strategies for mitigation.
Provides guidance for arranging critical information near attention-favored positions.
Includes heuristic Python utilities for context health and poisoning indicators.
limitations: The included detector uses heuristics and simulated attention estimates.
It does not replace model-specific evaluation or production telemetry.
Model benchmark claims may become outdated as providers release new models.
It requires users to supply relevant context, goals, and failure examples.

use_cases.title: Debug Long Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Identify whether errors come from lost context, poisoned assumptions, distractors, or task confusion.

use_cases.title: Design Reliable Context Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan compaction, retrieval filtering, and task isolation before a production agent reaches context limits.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Prompt and Retrieval Changes
use_cases.description: Compare context layouts and retrieval choices against known degradation patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Spot Degradation Signs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a failing conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent conversation for context degradation signs. Identify the likely pattern, evidence, and one mitigation.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Context Layout
prompt_templates.scenario: Rearrange a prompt or session summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this context layout. Recommend where to place goals, constraints, evidence, and recent decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Mitigation Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Select a response to growing context size
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this agent workflow, choose write, select, compress, or isolate strategies. Explain tradeoffs and trigger points.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this production agent failure for poisoning, distraction, confusion, clash, and lost-in-middle effects. Provide prioritized remediation.

output_examples.input: An agent forgets a requirement introduced halfway through a long design review.
output_examples.output: Likely lost-in-middle degradation. Move the requirement into the current task block and repeat it near the final instruction.

output_examples.input: A retrieval system returns current and outdated policy documents in one answer context.
output_examples.output: Likely context clash. Mark the conflict, apply version priority rules, and remove outdated documents before generation.

output_examples.input: A coding agent starts using error messages from an earlier failed approach.
output_examples.output: Likely context poisoning. Preserve verified decisions, remove stale failure details, and restart from a clean summary.

best_practices: Place goals, constraints, and latest decisions at the beginning or end of context.
Filter retrieval results before adding them to the active prompt.
Create compaction and isolation triggers before context approaches model limits.
anti_patterns: Adding every retrieved document without relevance checks.
Keeping known wrong assumptions in context after correction.
Using one long session for unrelated tasks with different constraints.

faq.question: What is context degradation?
faq.answer: It is reduced model performance caused by long, conflicting, distracting, or polluted context.

faq.question: Does this skill run automatic diagnostics?
faq.answer: It includes heuristic Python utilities, but the main value is guided analysis and mitigation planning.

faq.question: Can it prevent hallucinations?
faq.answer: It can reduce hallucination risk by identifying poisoned context and weak evidence, but it cannot guarantee factual output.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps coding agents manage long task histories, tool outputs, and shifting requirements.

faq.question: When should I use compaction?
faq.answer: Use compaction when context grows large, repeated facts dominate, or the agent starts missing recent priorities.

faq.question: How should teams validate the advice?
faq.answer: Test prompts and agent workflows with progressively larger contexts and compare accuracy across layouts.
